title: Three states of matter (পদার্থের তিন অবস্থা)
placement: Book page 150, topic 5.6: পদার্থের তিন অবস্থা: কঠিন, তরল এবং গ্যাস, with চিত্র ৫.১৩ (kotin, torol, gas; on page 151). Put the animation in place of চিত্র ৫.১৩ or right after it, before the paragraph that begins যখন কোনো পদার্থ গ্যাস অবস্থায় থাকে.
description: Self-playing 3D animation, 72 s, looping, in five parts students can tap: a water molecule (one O, two H) that is no longer water when split; an ice cube in a steel pan on a gas stove, with a magnifier showing its molecules in a regular pattern, only vibrating; the flame melts it into water whose molecules stay close but slide past each other; the water boils, steam rises, and the lens shows the vapour's few molecules far apart, flying freely; last, the three states side by side as in চিত্র ৫.১৩, with curved arrows: তাপ দিলে one way, ঠান্ডা করলে back. Each state shows whether it has a fixed shape and a fixed volume, with an icon and words.
